faqItems.question: What is the difference between adding and extracting VAT (Net vs Gross)?
faqItems.answer: Adding VAT applies the rate on top of the net base: Base × (1 + Rate/100). Extracting VAT separates the tax already built into the invoice: Total × Rate / (100 + Rate), automatically determining the net base.

faqItems.question: How does US Sales Tax work?
faqItems.answer: The United States does not have a federal VAT. Instead, sales tax is levied on state, county, and municipal levels (ranging from 0% in Oregon or Delaware up to 7.25%–10% in California, New York, and Texas). Select an average or enter your exact zip code rate.

faqItems.question: What are standard VAT rates around the world?
faqItems.answer: EU countries standard rates average 19–22% (Germany 19%, France 20%, Italy 22%), the UK is 20%, Japan is 10%, UAE is 5%, Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan are 12%, and Switzerland is 8.1%.

faqItems.question: How is cross-border B2B export tax handled?
faqItems.answer: International export of goods and cross-border services typically qualify for 0% zero-rated VAT or the Reverse Charge Mechanism, whereby the customer accounts for VAT in their domestic territory.

faqItems.question: Can I use custom rates and decimal percentages?
faqItems.answer: Yes, you can enter any custom rate with decimals (e.g. 7.25%, 8.1%, or 19.5%) and the calculator will accurately compute every metric.

faqItems.question: How can I export the calculation for my accounting team?
faqItems.answer: Click 'Download PDF' to instantly receive a formal tax summary document, export the full figures to Excel (CSV), or copy values to your clipboard.

tipsItems.title: Clear commercial pricing:
tipsItems.text: always specify whether quotation figures are VAT inclusive (Gross) or VAT exclusive (Net) to avoid contract disputes.

tipsItems.title: Accounting rounding:
tipsItems.text: standard accounting rules round amounts to 2 decimal places using half-up arithmetic (0.005 rounds to 0.01).

tipsItems.title: Amount in words:
tipsItems.text: use the generated words string directly in invoice descriptions, commercial contracts, and official payment orders.

tipsItems.title: Instant PDF export:
tipsItems.text: generate timestamped, formal calculation certificates with full audit formulas for filing with primary accounting records.
